notes_ja: キーはD。イントロ（1〜11小節）はギターのD5（D3＋A3）の刻みだけで、8〜11小節に小さなシンセのふくらみ（D9系）が重なります。A（12〜21）は「D5｜D5 Csus2」の2小節パターンを3回→Am7（2小節）→D→G。Csus2の所はベースがC、ギターは3x00x1（G・D・G・F。1弦1フレットのFが入るので正確にはCsus4(add9)）、その上で（おそらくバイオリンの）低いCの重音（C4＋C5）が大きく鳴るため、耳にはCsus2（C・D・G）に聞こえます。B（22〜34）はD｜G｜Bm Asus4｜G｜D｜Asus4 Asus4/E（ベースがEに下りてもギターはAsus4のまま）のあと、「Bm｜G｜D A」を2回くり返して34小節目のDで終わります。Aの和音は3度（C#）が弱く、2弦3フレットのD（sus4）と開放B（sus2）を行き来するのが特徴です（24小節後半は左のギターがsus4、右のギターがsus2寄り）。30・33小節後半だけは左のギターがC#（x0222x）を弾くのでA。28・31小節の最後はベースがB→A→Gと下ります。
method: v3 harmony re-check. Chord recognisers: BTC (large vocabulary, 170 classes) and Chordino (NNLS chroma, slash chords), each run on 7 inputs: the full mix, guitar+bass mixes from three separators (BS-RoFormer SW 6-stem, htdemucs_6s, MVSep Mega-53 acoustic guitar + SW bass, and Mega acoustic + Mega guitar + SW bass), and guitar-only stems (Mega acoustic, SW guitar). Their labels were reduced to one label per half bar (longest-overlap) and compared with v2 (final_parts/chords.json). Pitch evidence per half bar and per eighth: basic-pitch note posteriors on the Mega acoustic-guitar and SW guitar stems (left, right and side channels separately), 8192-point STFT peak levels per semitone (+8 c tuning) for every stem and channel, 4096-point per-eighth tables, 64k-point zoomed spectra, linear spectrogram images (B3-D4 region, bars 24/27/30/33), and the bass, drums, violin, synth and vocal stems to rule out leakage (bass harmonics, snare energy around 250-300 Hz, violin partials). Decision rule: root = bass note; a tone is part of the symbol if it is sustained in the accompaniment (guitar/bass/pad) in both guitar channels or in at least two separators and is not explained as a harmonic or leakage; violin melody notes do not change the symbol. Bass passing notes shorter than a half bar are listed in passing_chords, not in chords.
